cards.title: Elven Warrior
cards.gameText: Valiant. While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [ELVEN] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.
cards.lore: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.

cards.title: Focus
cards.gameText: Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [DWARVEN] Dwarf or hunter [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [ELVEN] Elf strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas...'”

cards.title: Haldir
cards.subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2. While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.
cards.lore: “‘...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befirend you, as Elrond asked...'”

cards.title: Ithilien Blade
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to wound a roaming minion twice.
cards.lore: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.

cards.title: Madril
cards.subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
cards.gameText: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [GONDOR] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2. At the start of the Maneuver phase, for each threat you can spot, make a minion's site number +1 until the start of the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'”

cards.title: Mountain-troll
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [ORC] minions from play to make it strength +10 and fierce until the end of the turn. Shadow: Remove (2) to play an [ORC] Orc from your discard pile. It comes into play exhausted.
cards.lore: “Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.”

cards.title: Little Golden Flower
cards.gameText: Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon takes no more than 1 wound per skirmish. Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1. Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'”
